svg.aria-label: Player profile. Hi, I'm Mohamed. Now: working with two companies. A full-stack engineer based in Egypt. For more than five years I have shipped production work for clients in six countries. I came to code from marketing, so I judge a website by what it does for the business: how fast it opens, whether people and search engines find it, and whether visitors act on it. I build with Next.js, TypeScript and MongoDB, ship Arabic-first when the audience is, and treat motion as part of the product, not decoration.
